title: Two orchestrator rules answer as tested _self questions: finishing a story whose tasks are all done, and KB-Work for a planning commit of several items
goal: The _self pack answers 'how is a story whose tasks are all done finished' and 'how does a planning commit that changes several item files name them in KB-Work' with coverage good from a tested question each (both weak on 2026-10-13, rules misses of the SP-honlhzdc orchestrator)

run: import subprocess,sys;Q=['how is a story whose tasks are all done finished','how does a planning commit that changes several item files name them in KB-Work'];H=[(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self',q,'--budget','200'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() or [''])[0] for q in Q];print(H);sys.exit(0 if all(h.startswith('coverage: good (tested question') for h in H) else 1)
